statement: Primary source Table 1 row 1105 (19): GluN2A N.E., GluN2B 113, GluN2C 7.0, GluN2D 2.7 uM (fitted IC50); Table 3 means (rat oocytes, glutamate) 206 +/- 36, 121 +/- 32, 8.5 +/- 1.2, 2.7 +/- 0.2 uM
system: rat cDNA, Xenopus oocytes, TEVC, 100 uM glutamate + 30 uM glycine, pH 7.4, 23 C

statement: Registry rows for 21807990: GluN2D 2700 nM equals the source 2.7 uM; GluN2C 7.0 nM and GluN2B 113 nM equal the source numbers 7.0 and 113 but the source unit is uM, so both differ by a factor 1000; the GluN2C wording on the GluN2B row is the registry assay text, not the paper's
producer_status: numeric identity DATO; cause (uM stored as nM) INFERENZA

statement: The only real registry inconsistency was GluN2D (2700 nM) above GluN2B (113 nM), now explained by the unit slip; the source own ratios are about 16-fold (GluN2B vs GluN2C, Table 1) and about 42-fold (GluN2B vs GluN2D), and the abstract states at least 50-fold as a general statement

Mechanism as stated by the source: inhibition voltage-independent (no change across voltages, p=0.86, n=5), not surmounted by glutamate or glycine, consistent with noncompetitive action; single-channel mean open time and conductance unchanged
system: oocytes and HEK outside-out patches (-80 mV, pH 8.0)

statement: On the source numbers DQP-1105 is a GluN2C/GluN2D-preferring noncompetitive inhibitor: GluN2B about 113-121 uM (oocytes, rat), 206 +/- 137 uM human GluN2B, N.E. in BHK Ca imaging; so it is an exclusion for a GluN2B comparison, not a GluN2B comparator (no statement of benefit or harm for WWOX). Scope limits: the GluN2B IC50 is a fitted value with complete inhibition assumed (highest concentration tested and maximum at GluN2B not reported), so it is an order-of-10^2 uM parameter; GluN2B was not assayed in the HEK patch configurations, where GluN2A selectivity is weak (12 against 3.2 uM dialysed, 54 against 2.1 uM perforated); N.E. means no detectable effect at the concentrations evaluated, and the BHK 65 +/- 3 percent at 33 uM is a GluN2A figure
The 2023 paper from the same group (overlapping authors) cites Acker 2011 (its reference 32) as GluN2C 7.0 uM and GluN2D 2.7 uM, agreeing with the primary Table 1 and with the registry GluN2D row
Same-group re-measurement in another system (HEK293, whole-cell, rat GluN1/GluN2D, -60 mV): IC50 1.4 uM (peak) and 0.72 uM (steady state), N=9 cells; supplement Figure S1 unread

Maximum inhibition at saturation is not reported per subunit for DQP-1105 in the text and table read; the fits assume complete inhibition, and BHK GluN2A reached 65 +/- 3% of control at 33 uM (Figures not viewed)
